observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission/gearbox with engine components, wiring, and fluid lines still attached, resting on wooden planks in a workshop.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from a slightly different angle, with the bell housing, output shaft, and cooler lines visible.
Photo 2 shows the unit from above with a person’s legs nearby, confirming it is a large rear-wheel-drive transmission.
All three photos carry a “GEARUP INC.” watermark and “POSTED ON JIJI” text.
No identification plate, part number, brand logo, or model marking is legible in any photo.
